result.title: Efficient Remote Sensing Image-Text Retrieval via Interaction-Free Recall and Text-Guided Reranking
result.summary: Remote sensing (RS) image-text retrieval plays a critical role in understanding massive RS imagery. However, the dense multi-object distribution and complex backgrounds in RS imagery make it difficult to simultaneously achieve fine-grained cross-modal alignment and efficient retrieval. Existing methods either rely on complex cross-modal interactions that lead to low retrieval efficiency, or depend on large-scale vision-language adaptation, which requires massive data and computational resources. To address these issues, we develop a fast-then-fine (FTF) retrieval framework centered on interaction-free multi-granular recall and parameter-free text-guided cross-modal reranking with the Balanced Text-guided Interaction Block (BTIB). Specifically, interaction-free multi-granular recall pre-computes gallery embeddings and matches them with the corresponding query embedding without full-gallery token-level text-image interaction, while text-guided cross-modal reranking with BTIB refines local semantic correspondence within the top-K candidate set. Furthermore, an inter- and intra-modal loss is designed to jointly optimize cross-modal alignment across multi-granular representations. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that the FTF achieves competitive retrieval accuracy while significantly improving retrieval efficiency compared with existing methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 fast-then-fine 的遥感图文检索框架：先用免交互的多粒度召回预计算图库嵌入完成粗筛，再仅对 top-K 候选做文本引导的跨模态重排序与局部语义对齐，并配以模态内外联合损失，在保持精度的同时提升检索效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「廉价全局召回触发、仅对 top-K 做昂贵细粒度交互」的两段式结构，可能为 LVR 中何时调用高成本视觉证据、如何做候选证据筛选提供线索，但原文面向检索排序，未涉及推理状态或答案生成，需核查可迁移性。
